## Continuous stream (information; sliding window, every sample)

`x310_data.make_stream(65536, seed 0)`: 65,473 windows, 54,182 wholly inside one pulse or gap, 11,291 straddling an edge. Decisions of the exported model on the pure windows agree with the label 89.8 % of the time (noise / CW / LFM / BPSK: 98.9 / 98.2 / 88.6 / 75.1 %). The stream is a different draw (noise floor fixed at -40 dBFS, pulse SNR uniform over -5..25 dB), not the test distribution.
